grundsaetze: People decide: AI makes suggestions; decisions about people, safety and quality are taken by a responsible person.
We use AI only for defined purposes and assess every system for risks and consequences for affected persons before it is used.
Customers, applicants and employees are told when they are dealing with AI and where they can report questions or concerns.
We enter confidential design data, customer data and export-controlled technology only into systems approved for this purpose.
We treat people fairly: we check systems that affect people for bias and have them overseen by humans.
We develop AI in our products according to a defined life cycle with testing, approval and monitoring in the field.
We comply with applicable laws, in particular data protection, export control, the EU AI Act and the Machinery Regulation, and meet our customers' requirements.

We request new AI tools from the AIMS lead before use; she decides alone for low risk, together with the system owner for medium risk, and the executive board decides where the risk is high. Errors, incidents and concerns can be reported without disadvantage.
We continually improve the AI management system based on objectives, audits and feedback.

kiSysteme.name: Visual quality inspection line 3
kiSysteme.beschreibung: Supplier camera system with a learning image classifier at the inspection station of production line 3. The base model comes from the supplier; quality assurance retrains it with its own images of good and defective parts (function in the supplier's system).
kiSysteme.zweck: Detect surface defects (scratches, shrinkage cavities, burrs) on turned and milled components and divert suspicious parts for re-inspection.
kiSysteme.betroffene: Quality assurance employees (re-inspection), indirectly customers through the quality of the parts delivered.

ressourcen.daten: About 40,000 images from our own production (good parts and 9 defect classes), labelled by QA; test set of 3,000 images, versioned.
ressourcen.werkzeuge: Software of the camera supplier with training function, model version 3.3 (retrained on 27/01/2027, approved using QS-F-118).
ressourcen.rechenressourcen: Industrial PC with graphics card at the inspection station in the OT network; retraining done locally, no cloud.
ressourcen.personal: Two QA specialists trained by the supplier, shift supervisors for re-inspection.

kiSysteme.datenqualitaet: Labelling accuracy of at least 98% in a double check of 5% of the images, at least 300 images per defect class, test set with all 9 defect classes and no more than 60% good parts; checked before every retraining (QS-F-118).

art5.begruendung: Image inspection of components without reference to persons; no practice under Art. 5(1).

produkt.begruendung: Inspection system of our own production, not part of the delivered parts or machines. It inspects only surface characteristics without a safety function; safety-relevant characteristics are inspected by QA according to the inspection plan without AI.

aiAct.begruendung: Deployer of a purchased system, used only at the plant in Eastern Switzerland; the inspection decision is used in Switzerland, only the inspected parts go to the EU. There is therefore no link under Art. 2(1); the classification is made as a precaution. Used for quality control in our own production: not an Annex III use case and not a safety component of a product under Annex I. Retraining with our own images does not change the intended purpose; a change of role under Art. 25(1) would only matter for a high-risk system. Internally, every retraining counts as a change under D-12 with approval by the Head of Quality.

kiSysteme.auflagen: Only for diverting suspicious parts to re-inspection; retraining only by QA using form QS-F-118.
kiSysteme.freigabeBegruendung: Screening IA-001 decided as a borderline case and reassessed after the retraining runs of 20/11/2026 and 27/01/2027; every model version is tested against the test set before use and approved by the Head of Quality. Approved by the executive board (decision of 13/10/2026, N-058) because the system controls the diverter without confirmation by a person (risk appetite D-03).
kiSysteme.protokollierung: Inspection decisions with image, characteristic and confidence kept for 12 months on the inspection station; model versions and retraining runs in the supplier's change log.
kiSysteme.nutzerinformation: Work instruction for the line 3 inspection station with the limits of the function; briefing of inspectors.
kiSysteme.aufsicht: QA specialists check every diverted part at the inspection station; the shift supervisor decides in the event of faults; model versions are approved by the Head of Quality (QS-F-118), not by the system owner.
kiSysteme.aenderungsregel: Retraining only by QA using form QS-F-118: image set with label check, test against the test set of 3,000 images, comparison of the detection rate per defect class, approval by the Head of Quality, filing of the model version. After every retraining the system owner reassesses the risks of the system (D-07). A change is substantial if inspection characteristics, part families or thresholds are changed or if the detection rate on the test set drops by more than 2 percentage points; a new screening (D-09) then follows as well.
kiSysteme.zugriffe: Camera images of the inspection station, signal to the reject gate of line 3, local image storage; no access to the ERP or office IT.
kiSysteme.stoppmoeglichkeit: Switch to manual inspection at the control panel of the inspection station by the shift supervisor or QA; the gate then rejects all parts for visual inspection. Only QA restores an earlier model version.

modell.name: Image classifier of the camera system, retrained with our own images

kiSysteme.rueckfallweg: Visual inspection of all parts by QA according to the inspection plan; this covers half the throughput of the line, so QA adds a shift from the second day.
kiSysteme.abhaengigkeiten: Before the system, the turning and milling cells of line 3; after it, assembly and function testing, QM system for escape rate and complaints.

einsatzentscheid.nutzen: Fewer false rejects and less re-inspection, about CHF 120,000 per year (R-022); consistent inspection across all shifts.
einsatzentscheid.alternativeOhneKi: Image processing with fixed rules and thresholds assessed: it does not reliably detect cavities and burrs on changing surfaces. Visual inspection alone would need two additional positions.

messkonzept.zielkonflikte: Detection rate before throughput: better to reject more parts for re-inspection than to let a defect pass.

pruefungen.prueffaelle: Test set with 3,000 images of all 9 defect classes
pruefungen.messgroesse: Detection rate per defect class and escape rate in ppm
pruefungen.schwelle: Drop of more than 2 percentage points or escape rate above 50 ppm
pruefungen.haeufigkeit: before every model version, escape rate monthly
pruefungen.ergebnis: Version 3.3 on 27/01/2027 without a drop; escape rate in January 2027 29 ppm

unabhaengig.ergebnis: Test set and approval of version 3.3 under QS-F-118 retraced, no deviation.

kiSysteme.name: MX-Predict maintenance assistant (product function)
kiSysteme.beschreibung: Software function of the MX series assembly cells. A model trained in development analyses vibration, current and temperature data of spindles and axes on the machine control and estimates the remaining service life of wear parts. The analysis runs locally on the machine; field data do not flow back into training.
kiSysteme.zweck: Inform customers of maintenance needs early so that they can avoid unplanned downtime and plan service work (performance optimization, not a safety function).
kiSysteme.betroffene: Customers as deployers of the machines and their maintenance staff in the EU and Switzerland; indirectly our customer service.

ressourcen.daten: Measurement data from our own test benches and endurance tests (about 2.1 million measurement series, 2023 to 2026) and failure logs of the test benches.
ressourcen.werkzeuge: Own model (gradient boosting and threshold logic), model registry and version control, release 2.1 since November 2026.
ressourcen.rechenressourcen: Training on a development server in the data centre in eastern Switzerland; execution on the machine control.
ressourcen.personal: Two data scientists and four software engineers in development, product management, customer service for feedback.

art5.begruendung: Analysis of machine data without reference to persons; no practice under Art. 5(1).

produkt.begruendung: The MX assembly cells are machinery (Annex I Section B). MX-Predict serves only maintenance planning (performance optimization under Art. 6(1a)) and performs no protective task. Art. 6(1b) checked and answered in the negative: emergency stop, overload and temperature cut-off act independently in the safety control; if the function fails or errs, the panel shows a wrong notice or none, and the machine continues to run safely. The instructions for use exclude use for safety purposes. The product line is not machinery requiring third-party assessment. After the corrigendum of 29/09/2026 to Art. 6(1b), legally reviewed again by the legal adviser on 20/10/2026: result unchanged (N-055).

kiSysteme.name: Applicant pre-selection in the HR SaaS (shadow AI)
kiSysteme.beschreibung: AI function ‘candidate ranking’ of the applicant management software. The supplier activated it by default with a release in February 2026; it sorted applications by a fit score and marked applications below a threshold as ‘low suitability’. Discovered in the inventory interview with the HR department on 25/08/2026 and switched off the same day.
kiSysteme.zweck: Intended: pre-sort applications for advertised positions by fit with the job profile; the decision on interviews is always taken by the HR department and line management.
kiSysteme.betroffene: Applicants for positions in both companies (about 900 applications per year, of which about 250 for the German company); HR employees and line managers.

ressourcen.daten: Application documents (CV, references, cover letter) and job profiles; CVs sometimes contain sensitive personal data (health, religion, photo).
ressourcen.werkzeuge: HR SaaS of the supplier, function ‘candidate ranking’, configured by the HR department.
ressourcen.rechenressourcen: Cloud service of the supplier, data centre in Germany.
ressourcen.personal: Two recruiters, Head of Human Resources; line managers as co-decision-makers.

art5.begruendung: Evaluation of written documents; no emotion recognition at the workplace, no biometric categorization, no video or voice analysis (Art. 5(1)(f) and (g)).

produkt.begruendung: Function of HR software, not part of a product under Annex I.

aiAct.begruendung: Screening and evaluating applications falls under Annex III No. 4(a). The exception under Art. 6(3) does not apply because the system profiles people. The HR department at headquarters operates the system for both companies. For positions in the German company the output is used in the EU (Art. 2(1)(c)), and the German company takes part in the decisions as employer and is therefore itself a deployer established in the EU (point (b)). No registration, because we are not a public authority (Art. 49(3)). For these positions, the obligations under Art. 26 apply from 02/12/2027, in particular 26(7) information of employee representatives, 26(11) information of applicants and Art. 86 right to an explanation. For positions in Switzerland we apply the same rules voluntarily. A change of role under Art. 25(1) is ruled out as long as we do not change the supplier's intended purpose and model. We do not rely on the transitional rule under Art. 111(2) for high-risk systems placed on the market before 02/12/2027: the supplier changes the function with every release, and we will only put it back into service in a changed configuration. We therefore meet the obligations under Art. 26 from the time it is put back into service, at the latest from 02/12/2027. Legal assessment N-037.

kiSysteme.auflagen: Function switched off, as is the summary of job interviews newly offered with the release of 15/12/2026. Back in service only as a sorting aid without a threshold after M-019 is completed and the executive board has approved it.
kiSysteme.freigabeBegruendung: High-risk under Annex III No. 4(a); full assessment IA-008 and DPIA-2026-04. Function suspended until the bias tests are passed and the executive board approves putting it back into service (M-019).
kiSysteme.protokollierung: Pre-selection logs kept for 12 months by the supplier (N-018); decisions of the HR department in the application file.
kiSysteme.nutzerinformation: Planned from the time it is put back into service (M-020): notice in every job advertisement and in the acknowledgement of receipt that an AI system pre-sorts the documents and a person decides; right to an explanation.
kiSysteme.aufsicht: Before the system is put back into service: review of every application by a trained recruiter (K-001), half-yearly sample by the Head of Human Resources. At present, the HR department checks after every release whether the function remains switched off.
kiSysteme.zugriffe: Application documents and job requirement profiles in the HR SaaS; no interface to other systems.
kiSysteme.stoppmoeglichkeit: Switch the function off in the HR SaaS configuration (HR department, immediately); after every release the HR department checks that it stays switched off.
kiSysteme.rueckfallweg: Screening of every application without sorting, as before 2026.
kiSysteme.abhaengigkeiten: Job advertisements and incoming applications in the HR SaaS; after it, decision on interview invitations by the HR department and line management.
kiSysteme.missbrauchsfaelle: Planned before it is put back into operation: applications with hidden instructions and invisible text meant to raise the score, part of the tests in M-019.

einsatzentscheid.nutzen: Intended: faster screening for positions with more than 40 applications.
einsatzentscheid.alternativeOhneKi: Screening without sorting as before 2026: currently in use and sufficient for most positions. The function is only put back into operation if the benefit justifies the effort for the deployer obligations.

messkonzept.zielkonflikte: Fairness before time saved: no threshold and no flag, even though screening takes longer as a result.

pruefungen.prueffaelle: All applications with the sorting aid since it was put back into operation, cumulative, first analysis from 200 applications (M-019)
pruefungen.messgroesse: Ratio of invitation rates between groups (Z-009)

risiken.titel: Design data and know-how end up in generative AI
risiken.beschreibung: Employees enter confidential design data, customer drawings or calculations into ChatGPT Team to create texts or code.
risiken.ursache: High benefit for drafts and programming help, data classes not labelled in files, time pressure.
risiken.folge: Breach of non-disclosure agreements with customers, loss of know-how, contractual penalties and loss of a key account.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: ISMS classification of information, non-disclosure agreements, company accounts with training use excluded. Until M-008 was completed, use continued under a time-limited exception granted by the executive board on 13/10/2026 (until 30/11/2026). Residual risk accepted after M-008 was completed.

ausnahme.begruendung: Decision of the executive board meeting of 13/10/2026 (N-058): continued use of ChatGPT Team until the policy with data classes (M-008) took effect, on condition that ‘no confidential data’; closed on 30/11/2026.

risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Residual value 6 above the acceptance threshold of 4: some incorrect input cannot be ruled out by rules and training, and the service offers no technical block on content. The executive board bears the risk because of the benefit for engineering and purchasing (decision of the executive board meeting of 08/12/2026, N-058) and reviews it every six months with the Z-003 samples. The severity drops from 4 to 3 because the data classes of the policy (M-008) exclude confidential design data and customer drawings; what remains concerns individual documents, not whole designs.

risiken.titel: Export of export-controlled technology via cloud AI
risiken.beschreibung: Technical data on dual-use assemblies are entered into an AI service with processing in the USA.
risiken.ursache: The export control status is not consistently visible in design files; users do not know the rule.
risiken.folge: Breach of the Goods Control Ordinance, criminal proceedings, withdrawal of export licences.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Export control officer in purchasing, labelling in the ERP.

risiken.titel: Copilot finds data because of overly broad permissions
risiken.beschreibung: Copilot shows content from Teams and folders that users can technically access but that is not intended for them (e.g. payroll lists, quotations from other departments).
risiken.ursache: Sharing settings in SharePoint and Teams that have grown over time, shares ‘for everyone in the company’.
risiken.folge: Breach of the confidentiality of personal data and trade secrets, obligation to notify the supervisory authority.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Annual recertification of permissions in the ISMS (27001-5.18). The acceptance applies to the residual value after M-010 is completed; until then the libraries of HR, finance and the executive board are excluded from search.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-010 (due 31/03/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 9 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because the libraries of HR, finance and the executive board are already excluded from the search and the remaining shares will be cleaned up by the end of March (decision of 24/11/2026, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Incorrect information and insecure code from generative AI
risiken.beschreibung: Copilot or ChatGPT Team produce plausible but incorrect performance data, references to standards or calculations that are adopted unchecked into quotations or design documents. When helping with control scripts (KI-005), the assistant suggests libraries that do not exist or that an attacker provides under that name, or code with security flaws.
risiken.ursache: Hallucinations of the language models, automation bias, no review routine, code adopted without testing.
risiken.folge: Incorrect assurances to customers, warranty cases, rework in design; malicious code or malfunctions in control scripts.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Four-eyes principle for quotations above CHF 100,000; control scripts only run after testing in the development environment.

risiken.titel: Misclassification after retraining lets defective parts through
risiken.beschreibung: A retrained model recognizes a defect class less well than before; defective parts reach assembly or the customer.
risiken.ursache: Unbalanced image sets, incorrectly labelled images, no check against a fixed test set.
risiken.folge: Customer complaints, sorting campaigns, escape rate above the target of 50 ppm.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Functional test in assembly, visual inspection by sampling. Reassessed on 28/01/2027 after the retraining runs of 20/11/2026 (model version 3.2) and 27/01/2027 (version 3.3) and after finding F-001: in both versions the detection rate per defect class on the test set did not drop, and slippage was 29 ppm in January 2027. The retraining of 20/11/2026 without approval shows, however, that the test before use could be bypassed; since M-026 only QA can retrain, and with M-035 a reassessment follows every retraining. Likelihood 2 and severity 4 before, 1 and 3 after treatment confirmed; residual risk accepted again on 02/02/2027.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-035 (due 26/02/2027). The severity drops from 4 to 3 because the function test in assembly catches faulty parts before delivery; an escape remains a quality loss at the customer, not a hazard. Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 8 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because every model version is approved using QS-F-118 (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Retraining is not treated as a change
risiken.beschreibung: QA retrains the model for new part families without a change request, test and approval; a substantial change is not recognized.
risiken.ursache: The training function is enabled for users; the ISMS change process did not cover AI models.
risiken.folge: Uncontrolled model versions, no traceability in case of complaints, wrong classification.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: ISMS change process for software and network. Reassessed on 28/01/2027 after finding F-001: measures M-026 and M-035 added, residual risk accepted again on 02/02/2027.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-035 (due 26/02/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 9 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because since M-026 only QA can retrain (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Remote access by the camera supplier to the OT network
risiken.beschreibung: The supplier accesses the industrial PC remotely for model updates and support.
risiken.ursache: The support contract provides for permanent remote access.
risiken.folge: Entry point into production IT, production outage.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: ISMS remote maintenance process with case-by-case enabling and logging (27001-8.20, 8.22). Reassessed on 28/01/2027 after the retraining runs and finding F-001: retraining runs locally without remote access; assessment unchanged, residual risk accepted again on 02/02/2027.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-021 (due 30/04/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 8 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because remote access is enabled only case by case and every session is logged; the contract amendment makes this rule binding (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Wrong forecast by the maintenance function at the customer
risiken.beschreibung: MX-Predict reports wear too late or too often.
risiken.ursache: Operating conditions at the customer differ from those on the test benches.
risiken.folge: Unplanned downtime or unnecessary service calls, complaints, warranty claims.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Validation per release, notice levels instead of fixed dates.

risiken.titel: Maintenance function takes over safety tasks
risiken.beschreibung: Customers link the maintenance notice to a shutdown, or a future function takes over protective tasks. MX-Predict would then be a safety component of the machine (Art. 6(1)(a) or 6(1b)), and the classification as performance optimization under Art. 6(1a) would no longer apply.
risiken.ursache: Functional extensions without reassessment, integration at the customer.
risiken.folge: New conformity assessment of the MX product line under the Machinery Regulation; the AI requirements would come through its Annex III (delegated act from 02/08/2028). Retrofitting of delivered machines, liability.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Safety functions in the safety control, conformity assessment under the Machinery Regulation.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-024 (due 30/09/2027). The severity remains 4; the measures only lower the likelihood. Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 8 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because the instructions for use and the contract exclude use for safety purposes (M-014; decision of 10/11/2026, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Data drift with new materials and tools
risiken.beschreibung: Forecast quality drops when customers use new tools, materials or cycle times that are missing from the test bench data.
risiken.ursache: Training only with test bench data, no field data.
risiken.folge: Gradually poorer notices, loss of trust.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Feedback from customer service.

risiken.titel: Customers doubt how their machine data is used
risiken.beschreibung: Customers fear that production data flow to us or are used for other purposes.
risiken.ursache: No contractual rules on data use for older deliveries.
risiken.folge: Function switched off, loss of trust, obstacle to sales.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Local analysis, remote transmission only with consent.

risiken.titel: Forecast model without validation and versioning
risiken.beschreibung: Changes to the forecast model are adopted without testing against comparison periods; model versions cannot be traced.
risiken.ursache: Developed as a one-person project, no development process.
risiken.folge: Planning errors, excess stock of more than CHF 500,000 or delivery delays.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Plausibility check by the planning team.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-012 (due 31/03/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 9 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because the planning team checks every forecast for plausibility before adopting it and a planning error can be corrected with the next monthly plan (decision of 24/11/2026, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again. The severity drops from 3 to 2 because a versioned and validated forecast (M-012) limits a planning error to one planning period.

risiken.titel: Dependence on a key person for the forecast model
risiken.beschreibung: Only one person can run and further develop the model.
risiken.ursache: Small planning department, no deputy.
risiken.folge: Forecast unavailable during absences, fallback to manual planning.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Planning can be done manually.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-013 (due 30/06/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 6 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because planning continues manually if the person is absent and only becomes slower (decision of 24/11/2026, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Chatbot names the wrong spare parts
risiken.beschreibung: The spare parts assistant gives a wrong or invented part number.
risiken.ursache: Gaps in the catalogue, similar assemblies, the language model fills in missing information.
risiken.folge: Wrong order, downtime at the customer, in the worst case installation of a wrong part.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Orders placed only by the customer, bill of materials checked by the fitter.

risiken.titel: Missing AI notice in the customer portal
risiken.beschreibung: Customers do not realize that they are talking to an AI system, for example because the notice is missing after a change to the portal or is overlooked in one language.
risiken.ursache: Changes to the portal without checking the notices, notice not in every answer.
risiken.folge: Breach of Art. 50(1) AI Act, loss of trust.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Notice in the chat window since the launch in March 2026, terms of use.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Residual value 2 after M-016, accepted. The severity drops from 3 to 2 because the notice in every answer and the referral to customer service limit a confusion with a specialist to individual conversations.

risiken.titel: Misuse of the chatbot through manipulated inputs
risiken.beschreibung: Attackers use prepared input to try to make the assistant output internal data, data of other customers or unwanted content.
risiken.ursache: Publicly accessible language model, new attack patterns; manipulated input is ordinary text that a web application firewall does not recognize.
risiken.folge: Disclosure of internal data or of conversation histories with personal data, reputational damage.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: The assistant sees the catalogue, bills of materials, stock and the list of machines of the logged-in account, but no data of other accounts and no special prices; the application, not the model, checks which account data belong to. Only the customer places orders, answers load no external images or links, input and requests per account are limited, and the system instructions contain no secrets.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Residual value 4 after the penetration test (M-017), accepted. The severity drops from 3 to 2 because the assistant only reads the catalogue and reaches neither data of other accounts nor actions; misuse remains limited to wrong answers in the own conversation.

risiken.titel: Mistranslated safety instructions and warnings in instructions for use
risiken.beschreibung: Unchecked AI translations change the meaning of warnings (e.g. ‘not’ missing, wrong units).
risiken.ursache: Time pressure in the writing team, trust in the translation quality, no specialist review for all languages.
risiken.folge: Danger to operators, defect in the instructions for use under the Machinery Regulation, liability.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Since 21/08/2026 no safety and warning notices in the service; specialist review of every translation, German, English and French in-house, Italian and Polish by commissioned specialist translators. Continued use until M-018 is completed with a time-limited exception by the executive board of 13/10/2026 (until 12/04/2027, no more than 6 months under D-03).

ausnahme.begruendung: Decision of the executive board meeting of 13/10/2026 (N-058): risk unacceptable before treatment (value 12); continued use only for descriptive text blocks of the class ‘public’ without safety and warning notices with specialist review of every translation, until L-006 is introduced (M-018).

risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Severity after treatment 3 instead of 4: safety and warning notices no longer go through the service, and every translation is reviewed by a specialist; a remaining error in descriptive texts can lead to operating errors, while warning notices and the machine's safeguards prevent danger to people. Accepted on condition that M-018 is completed by 09/04/2027; otherwise use ends with the exception on 12/04/2027.

risiken.titel: Confidential documentation in a free service
risiken.beschreibung: Complete instructions for use with design details were entered into a service without a contract.
risiken.ursache: Shadow AI without approval.
risiken.folge: Outflow of know-how, breach of customer agreements for special machines.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Since 21/08/2026 no confidential texts and no complete manuals in the service (condition in the approval list, checked by the head of technical writing); the risky use has thus stopped. Continued use for text blocks of the class ‘public’ until replacement is covered by R-017. Texts entered earlier cannot be retrieved; checked: no special machines with a confidentiality agreement affected.

risiken.titel: Discrimination against applicants through pre-selection
risiken.beschreibung: The fit score disadvantages groups of applicants (age, origin, gender, gaps in the CV).
risiken.ursache: Patterns in the supplier's training data, unsuitable job profiles, automation bias.
risiken.folge: Breach of the prohibition of discrimination, lawsuits, breach of the AI Act from 02/12/2027, reputational damage as an employer.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Function switched off since 25/08/2026. Residual risk accepted only for the switched-off state; new assessment and acceptance by the executive board before it is put back into service.

risiken.titel: Applicants and employee representatives not informed
risiken.beschreibung: Applicants do not know that their documents are being evaluated and cannot request an explanation; the employee representatives are not involved.
risiken.ursache: Function activated silently, privacy notice not updated.
risiken.folge: Breach of Art. 26(7), 26(11) and 86 AI Act from 02/12/2027 and of data protection information obligations.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Function switched off. Residual risk accepted only for the switched-off state; new assessment and acceptance by the executive board before it is put back into service.

risiken.titel: Expand the service business with predictive maintenance
risiken.beschreibung: Maintenance contracts with plannable service calls based on the notices from MX-Predict; target: 40 new service contracts by the end of 2027.
risiken.ursache: Customer demand for availability guarantees.
risiken.folge: Recurring revenue, stronger customer loyalty.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Customer service with 14 technicians in CH and DE.

risiken.titel: Less scrap through retrained quality inspection
risiken.beschreibung: Defect classes retrained with our own images reduce false rejects and re-inspection effort.
risiken.ursache: Image data from three years of production.
risiken.folge: About CHF 120,000 less inspection and scrap costs per year.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Escape rate and false reject metrics in QM.

risiken.titel: Time saved in quotations and design
risiken.beschreibung: Generative AI shortens quotation texts, minutes and research; an estimated 2 hours per week and person for 60 users.
risiken.ursache: Licences and training.
risiken.folge: More time for customer advice and engineering.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Key user network.

risiken.titel: Supplier changes the base model of the camera system without notice
risiken.beschreibung: A software update from the supplier replaces the base model; our own retraining behaves differently from what was tested. Identified in the internal audit when checking similar cases for finding F-002.
risiken.ursache: Support contract without an obligation to announce model changes.
risiken.folge: Undetected deterioration of the inspection, escapes.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Updates only after approval by OT.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-021 and M-027 (due 30/04/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 6 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because updates of the camera system are installed only after approval by OT and every retraining is tested against the test set (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: New AI functions are activated silently in existing software
risiken.beschreibung: As with the HR SaaS, suppliers activate AI functions with a release without the inventory being informed.
risiken.ursache: Release notes are not evaluated, supplier review without AI check items (finding F-002).
risiken.folge: Unknown AI systems, in the worst case high-risk use without measures.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Inventory survey 2026, approval process for new tools.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-027 (due 31/03/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 9 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because the inventory survey and the approval process capture new tools and IT has been evaluating the release notes of the major SaaS services since January 2027 (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: The legal status of the AI Act changes after the version of 27/07/2026
risiken.beschreibung: New consolidations, corrigenda, Commission guidelines or delegated acts change deadlines or classifications after we have recorded roles, classes and obligations. Identified with improvement suggestion F-004 in the internal audit.
risiken.ursache: The AI Act is continuously supplemented by guidelines, standards and legal acts; our classifications are based on a fixed status.
risiken.folge: Wrong deadlines or obligations in E-02, E-03 and E-09, late implementation, finding in the certification audit.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Annual review of role and classification (D-24), advice from the data protection adviser.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-028 (due 19/02/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 6 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because the annual review of role and classification and the advice of the data protection advisor capture changes in the legal situation until stage 1 (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Prepared email makes Copilot disclose internal data
risiken.beschreibung: An incoming email or attachment contains hidden instructions. When Copilot summarizes the email or searches documents, it follows the instructions and passes on internal content in an answer, a link or a draft. Identified with the near miss F-005.
risiken.ursache: Copilot reads incoming emails and documents with the users' rights; hidden instructions cannot be reliably separated from the rest of the text.
risiken.folge: Leakage of quotations, design data or personal data without any action by the users, duty to notify, loss of customer trust.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Provider updates; agents, plugins and connectors blocked; libraries of HR, finance and the executive board excluded from search (M-010); email filter and phishing training of the ISMS.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-029 and M-010 (due 31/03/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 6 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because agents and connectors are blocked, the mail filter holds back mail from unknown senders and users report requests in summaries (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Cost explosion through misuse of the public assistant
risiken.beschreibung: Automated, very long or very many requests through portal accounts drive up the consumption of the cloud AI platform; the platform charges by consumption.
risiken.ursache: Publicly accessible assistant, billing by consumption, so far only a warning at 80% of the monthly budget.
risiken.folge: Unexpected costs, in the worst case the assistant is switched off for all customers.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Sign-in to the portal required; platform warning at 80% of the monthly budget.

risiken.titel: Manipulated catalogue entry steers the assistant's answers
risiken.beschreibung: An entry in the catalogue or a bill of materials contains a hidden instruction or false information, for example after a faulty import of supplier data or through a person with write permissions; the assistant adopts it in its answers.
risiken.ursache: The knowledge base is maintained from several sources; so far, changes in the catalogue needed no second approval.
risiken.folge: Wrong recommendations to customers, incorrect orders, in the worst case references to external sites.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Spare parts catalogue editorial team, daily reconciliation of part numbers with the ERP, test case with a prepared entry in the test catalogue.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-031 (due 30/04/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 6 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because part numbers are reconciled with the ERP daily and answers appear only with a catalogue match and source (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Hidden instructions in web pages and files steer ChatGPT Team
risiken.beschreibung: ChatGPT Team reads third-party web pages through web search and files uploaded from customers or suppliers. Hidden instructions in them change the answer, for example with a link to a third-party page or a wrong recommendation.
risiken.ursache: The language model does not reliably separate instructions from the content it reads; web search is switched on for research.
risiken.folge: Wrong information in correspondence or control scripts, disclosure of input through a link, loss of trust.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: No connectors, custom GPTs or actions; only data up to class ‘internal’; misuse cases with a prepared web page and customer email passed before approval; results must be checked.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-034 (due 30/06/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 6 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because no connectors or actions are enabled, only data up to the class ‘internal’ are entered and results are checked before use (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Model change of the cloud AI platform changes the assistant's answers
risiken.beschreibung: The platform replaces the language model or a component (filters, retrieval); answers, block list or labelling then behave differently from what was tested.
risiken.ursache: Supply chain with the provider's model and components, whose development we cannot influence.
risiken.folge: Wrong part numbers, bypassed block list or missing labelling until the next test.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Model changes announced 60 days in advance (L-004), test catalogue with the misuse group before every change, model and version in the inventory.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-027 (due 31/03/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 6 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because model changes are announced 60 days in advance and tested beforehand with the test catalogue (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Model change at ChatGPT Team without notice
risiken.beschreibung: The provider changes the default model or functions of the workspace without prior notice; rules and misuse cases are based on an earlier state.
risiken.ursache: Direct contract without an obligation to announce model changes (PF-06 open).
risiken.folge: Different answer quality or new functions, such as connectors, without review.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Admin console with blocked functions, release notes of the provider.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Accepted for the residual value after completion of M-027 (due 31/03/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 6 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because connectors and new functions remain blocked in the admin console until they have been checked (decision of 02/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

risiken.titel: Outdated search index makes the assistant recommend superseded spare parts
risiken.beschreibung: The search index of the spare parts assistant is built from the spare parts catalogue every night. If the run fails or a deleted entry remains in the index, the assistant recommends superseded parts or old prices, and the answer still seems consistent.
risiken.ursache: Index and catalogue are maintained in separate processes; a failure of the nightly run only shows in the logs of the platform.
risiken.folge: Wrong orders by customers, returns and effort in service; for safety-relevant parts, wrong replacements.
risiken.bestehendeMassnahmen: Daily reconciliation of part numbers with the ERP (M-031), samples of answers by the spare parts catalogue editorial team.
risiken.restrisikoBegruendung: Severity 4, because a wrong replacement for safety-relevant parts can endanger safety at the machine (scale level 4, as question 2 in IA-006); the treatment only lowers the likelihood. Accepted for the residual value 4 after completion of M-040 (due 31/03/2027). Until then the executive board carries the value before treatment of 8 (medium, above the acceptance threshold 4) because part numbers are reconciled with the ERP daily and the assistant gives no assembly or safety instructions (circular resolution of 04/02/2027, N-058). After completion the AIMS lead confirms the residual value in the register; otherwise the executive board decides again.

triage.begruendung: Question 5 yes: parts the system rates as good pass on without re-inspection; this affects part quality, not people. Controlled by the function test in assembly and the escape rate (objective Z-004, at most 50 ppm). Question 2 no: the surface characteristics inspected have no safety function; safety-relevant characteristics (dimensions, hardness, cracks in parts for medical technology and automotive) are inspected by QA according to the inspection plan without AI. No personal data. Borderline case decided by the AIMS lead: screening is sufficient (R-005, R-006).

folgenabschaetzungen.ergebnis: Screening is sufficient. Use approved; every retraining follows procedure D-12 with test set and QA approval.

neubeurteilungen.anlass: Retraining runs of 20/11/2026 (model version 3.2, reassessment made up after finding F-001) and 27/01/2027 (model version 3.3)
neubeurteilungen.ergebnis: Inspection characteristics, part families and thresholds unchanged, detection rate on the test set not reduced; no substantial change, screening remains sufficient. The risks of the system (R-005, R-006, R-007, R-022, R-024) were reassessed on the same day (D-07).

mitgewirkt: QA specialists at the inspection station

triage.begruendung: Question 2 no: MX-Predict performs no protective task; emergency stop, overload and temperature cut-off act independently in the safety control, and the machine continues to run safely after a failure or wrong forecast. Question 6 yes: product function in more than 600 delivered machines in the EU and Switzerland (borderline case). Because of the reach and the foreseeable misuse for safety purposes, the AIMS lead decided on a full assessment. The threshold for sensitive use under D-08 is not reached (question 6 only); the full assessment is precautionary.

folgenabschaetzungen.systembeschreibung: MX-Predict estimates the remaining service life of spindle bearings, ball screws and belts from vibration, current and temperature data and shows a maintenance notice in three levels (observe, plan, urgent) on the control panel. The model is trained in development with test bench data and delivered with each software release; it does not keep learning in the field.
folgenabschaetzungen.verwendungen: Planning of maintenance work by the customer's maintenance staff; basis for service offers from our customer service if the customer has approved remote transmission of the notices.
folgenabschaetzungen.fehlanwendungen: Using the notice as approval to continue operation despite a fault message from the safety control; extending maintenance intervals beyond the manufacturer's specifications; use on machines after modifications we do not know about.
folgenabschaetzungen.daten: Training: measurement series from our own test benches and endurance tests (2023 to 2026), failure logs; provenance and quality in the model register of development. Operation: sensor data of the machine concerned, analysed locally and overwritten after 30 days. No personal data.
folgenabschaetzungen.einsatzumfeld: Customers from the automotive, electrical and consumer goods industries run the assembly cells in multi-shift operation. Maintenance staff with varying experience read the notices on the panel or in the customer's maintenance system. We supply instructions for use, training at commissioning and updates; the customer is responsible for operation.

betroffene.gruppe: Customers as deployers of the machines
betroffene.wirkung: Fewer unplanned stoppages; with wrong forecasts, unnecessary service calls or unexpected failures with loss of production.
Better planning; risk that notices are misunderstood or safety messages are overridden.
No direct effect as long as safety functions remain independent.
Plannable service calls; extra effort for queries about false alarms.

rechenschaft.nutzen: Clear responsibility: product responsibility in development, operation at the customer; laid down in the contract and the instructions.
rechenschaft.schaden: Unclear liability questions if customers use the notices differently than intended.

transparenz.nutzen: The notice on the panel names the component, level and data basis; the instructions explain how the function works and its limits.
transparenz.schaden: Customers might expect an accuracy that the model does not have.

fairness.nutzen: No effect on people; not relevant.
fairness.schaden: No recognizable disadvantages for groups of people.

datenschutz.schaden: With remote transmission, shift patterns could allow conclusions about operators; therefore only aggregated notices.

zuverlaessigkeit.nutzen: Validated on 18 months of test bench data, hit rate 91% with a warning time of at least 5 days.
zuverlaessigkeit.schaden: Data drift with new tools, materials or climatic conditions at the customer.

sicherheit.nutzen: Early detection of wear reduces the risk of consequential damage.
sicherheit.schaden: False sense of security if notices override safety messages; limited by the instructions and the independent safety control.

erklaerbarkeit.nutzen: The conspicuous measured variable (e.g. bearing temperature) is stated with every notice.
erklaerbarkeit.schaden: Limited explainability of the model in individual cases.

umwelt.nutzen: Less scrap, fewer spare parts and less energy lost through downtime at the customer.
umwelt.schaden: Low energy demand for training (a few hours per release).

folgenabschaetzungen.ausfaelle: False alarm: unnecessary maintenance work, costs at the customer. Missed notice: unplanned downtime, in extreme cases consequential damage to the spindle; no danger to people because overload and temperature cut-offs in the safety control act independently. Function failure: display ‘no forecast’, the machine continues to run normally.
folgenabschaetzungen.massnahmen: Use for safety purposes excluded in the instructions for use and the contract (M-014); validation per release with approval by development and product management (A.6.2.4); monthly drift monitoring based on feedback from customer service (M-015); feedback channel in the customer portal; legal assessment of the classification (N-036); monitoring of the legal acts on Annex III of the Machinery Regulation (M-024).
folgenabschaetzungen.ergebnis: Use as a product function is justifiable. Not a safety component under Art. 6(1a); borderline case 6(1b) documented and ruled out as long as safety functions remain independent. Reassessment with every extension to new components, with remote control functions and at the latest with the delegated act under the Machinery Regulation.
folgenabschaetzungen.gesellschaft: Fewer stoppages and less spare parts consumption at customers reduce resource consumption; a false sense of security in maintenance could weaken trust in machine safety.
mitgewirkt: Two pilot customers of the MX series

triage.begruendung: Internal planning support without personal data and without any effect on individuals. Wrong forecasts have economic effects (stock, delivery dates) and are recorded in the risk register (R-012, R-013).

folgenabschaetzungen.ergebnis: Screening is sufficient. Use approved; planning decisions are taken by the planning team.

folgenabschaetzungen.systembeschreibung: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint for 60 licensed users; answers based on the documents and emails the person may access.
folgenabschaetzungen.verwendungen: Drafts of emails and reports, summaries of documents, emails and Teams meetings with the knowledge of the participants, search in own documents.
folgenabschaetzungen.fehlanwendungen: Analysis of the performance or behaviour of individual employees; summarizing emails from unknown senders without review; entering export-controlled data.
folgenabschaetzungen.daten: Documents, emails and meetings in the M365 tenant with the permissions of the users; libraries of HR, finance and the executive board excluded. Provider language model without training on our data according to the contract and the supplier review L-002.
folgenabschaetzungen.einsatzumfeld: Office work in all departments of both companies; users trained on policy D-15-EB.

betroffene.wirkung: Faster drafts; risk of seeing other people’s personal data or adopting faulty summaries.

betroffene.gruppe: Employees whose data is in folders and emails
betroffene.wirkung: Payroll and HR data could become visible to colleagues if permissions are too broad.
Receive drafts; their data in emails could leak through prepared content.

rechenschaft.nutzen: Owner Head of IT, approval by top management, rules in D-15-EB.
rechenschaft.schaden: Drafts could go to customers or suppliers without review.

transparenz.nutzen: Users know that Copilot generates drafts; marking rules in D-15-EB.
transparenz.schaden: Recipients do not always recognize AI drafts in emails.

fairness.nutzen: Equal access for all 60 licensed users with training.
fairness.schaden: Analyses of performance or behaviour are prohibited and technically blocked.

datenschutz.nutzen: Libraries of HR, finance and the executive board excluded from search.
datenschutz.schaden: Overly broad permissions expose personal data such as payroll lists (R-003).

zuverlaessigkeit.nutzen: Faster drafts and summaries in everyday office work.
zuverlaessigkeit.schaden: Faulty summaries are adopted; quarterly sample of the results.

sicherheit.nutzen: Agents, plug-ins and connectors blocked, ISMS email filter.
sicherheit.schaden: Hidden instructions in emails lead to leakage of internal data (R-027).

erklaerbarkeit.nutzen: Answers name the documents used as the source.
erklaerbarkeit.schaden: Why Copilot picks a document often remains unclear to users.

umwelt.nutzen: Less search time and fewer printed documents.
umwelt.schaden: Computing effort in the provider data centre, figures from the supplier review.

folgenabschaetzungen.ausfaelle: Wrong summary: decision on a wrong basis, hence review before passing on. Service outage: work without Copilot continues without interruption. Misuse through prepared emails: leakage of internal data, hence connectors blocked and reporting channel.
folgenabschaetzungen.massnahmen: Clean-up of permissions and sensitivity labels, exclusion of sensitive libraries from search, blocking of agents, plug-ins and connectors, protection against prepared emails, training and sample of the results.

triage.begruendung: Office support; results are checked by the users. Personal data only within the existing permissions; the risk of overly broad permissions is treated as R-003. No decisions about people. Meeting summaries: Teams meetings are only summarized with the participants' knowledge, and summaries are checked by the meeting chair before being passed on (question 5 no). Copilot assesses neither the performance nor the behaviour of employees; such analyses are prohibited in the responsible AI use policy, so there is no effect on employees in a dependent position (question 3 no). Back-check under D-08: R-003 and R-027 with impact 3 on people, hence a full assessment.

folgenabschaetzungen.ergebnis: Full assessment after the back-check. Restricted use with the rules of the IT leaflet on AI use of 18/08/2026 (N-056): the libraries of HR, finance and the executive board are excluded from search until the remaining permissions have been cleaned up (M-010); meeting summaries only with the participants' knowledge, no analysis of individual employees. The executive board approves the restricted use.

neubeurteilungen.anlass: Near miss F-005 of 25/01/2027: Copilot summarized a prepared email from an unknown sender and asked for the price list to be sent. Misuse cases repeated on 29/01/2027 with 4 prepared emails.
neubeurteilungen.ergebnis: Screening repeated: questions 1 to 6 still no, no effect on the rights of persons and no decisions about persons. The risk of data leakage through prepared content is assessed as risk R-027 and treated with M-029. The repeat test of 29/01/2027 failed: 11 of 12 cases passed (N-054). The executive board deliberately decides to continue the restricted use until M-029 is completed on 31/03/2027 (circular resolution of 29/01/2027, N-058).
Threshold from D-06-EB reached, full assessment in the annex; use remains restricted until M-010 and M-029; no sensitive use.

folgenabschaetzungen.verknuepfteDsfa: No DPIA needed (checked in the record of processing activities)
folgenabschaetzungen.gesellschaft: No effect beyond the company; customers and suppliers receive reviewed drafts at most.

triage.begruendung: Office support without decisions about people. The main risks are confidentiality and export control (R-001, R-002); they affect the company, not the fundamental rights of third parties. Question 2 no: the programming aid provides drafts of control scripts for the test benches and assembly cells; a script only runs after a test in the development environment and approval under D-12, and protective functions sit in the safety controller, which is not programmed with AI. A faulty script leads to malfunction or downtime but does not endanger people (R-004).

folgenabschaetzungen.ergebnis: Screening is sufficient. Approval with conditions, no restricted use under D-08: no data above the class ‘internal’, no export-controlled data (EC-01).

neubeurteilungen.anlass: Assessment of the risks of generative AI (N-04, risk ‘attacks with and on generative AI’ relevant for KI-005) and new risk R-030 (hidden instructions in web pages and files).
neubeurteilungen.ergebnis: Screening repeated: questions 1 to 6 still no; question 2 remains no because control scripts only run after testing and approval. Protection against hidden instructions is assessed as R-030 and treated with M-034; the trustworthiness characteristic ‘secure and resilient’ has been added to the measurement and test plan with the misuse cases (N-03). The conditions remain.

folgenabschaetzungen.verknuepfteDsfa: No DPIA needed (checked in the record of processing activities)

triage.begruendung: Publicly accessible for about 1,400 customer accounts in the EU and Switzerland, direct interaction under our name. Wrong information on spare parts could indirectly affect safety during maintenance. Question 5 no: the answers inform about parts and do not decide about people; customers check the part number before ordering.

folgenabschaetzungen.systembeschreibung: The spare parts assistant answers questions in German, English, French and Italian. It searches the spare parts catalogue, bills of materials and stock, formulates the answer with the language model of the cloud AI platform and always states the source (catalogue page, part number). Customers place orders themselves in the portal.
folgenabschaetzungen.verwendungen: Find the part number for a machine and assembly, query availability and delivery time, show suitable maintenance kits, hand over to customer service.
folgenabschaetzungen.fehlanwendungen: Questions about repair and assembly instructions, safety settings or modifications; attempts to query internal prices or data of other customers; use as a general chatbot.
folgenabschaetzungen.daten: Knowledge base: spare parts catalogue and bills of materials (own data, edited by customer service), stock from the ERP, list of machines of the logged-in portal account (machine type and serial number, without names of people); conversation histories kept for 90 days for quality analysis, then deleted. Language model: pre-trained by the platform, we do not retrain it; the provider's information on training data and tests (model card, summary of training content) is held for L-004 in N-027. By contract, the platform does not use the inputs for training.
folgenabschaetzungen.einsatzumfeld: Customer portal, accessible to registered customers. Users are maintenance and purchasing staff with varying language skills. Customer service monitors the answers on working days and takes over forwarded requests.

betroffene.wirkung: Faster part search; with a wrong part number, a wrong order and delay, in the worst case installation of a wrong part.
Orders outside office hours; risk of incorrect delivery time information.
Relief with standard requests; extra effort for corrections.

rechenschaft.nutzen: Product responsibility in customer service, approval of every release against the test catalogue.
rechenschaft.schaden: Customers might understand answers as a binding assurance.

transparenz.nutzen: Notice before the first conversation and in every answer: ‘Answer from an AI assistant, please check the part number’; source reference.
transparenz.schaden: Without a notice, confusion with a human expert (Art. 50(1)).

fairness.nutzen: The same information in four languages, also outside office hours.
fairness.schaden: Poorer answers in languages with fewer catalogue texts (Italian); test catalogue per language. Gap per language measured with Z-005, below the threshold of 3 percentage points.

datenschutz.nutzen: Account data only, no sensitive data; deletion after 90 days.
datenschutz.schaden: Users might write personal data into free text; notice and filter.

zuverlaessigkeit.nutzen: 97.8% correct answers in the test catalogue before approval.
zuverlaessigkeit.schaden: Invented part numbers where the catalogue has gaps; answer only with a catalogue hit. Catalogue or model change (R-029, R-031).

sicherheit.nutzen: No assembly or safety instructions, reference to the instructions for use.
sicherheit.schaden: Manipulated inputs could bypass filters; penetration test N-044. Wrong replacement for safety-relevant parts (R-033).

erklaerbarkeit.nutzen: Every answer names the catalogue source and assembly.
erklaerbarkeit.schaden: The reason for the choice between several matching parts is not always visible.

umwelt.schaden: Computing effort of the platform; EU region with the provider's information on energy demand.

folgenabschaetzungen.ausfaelle: Wrong part number: wrong order, return, downtime at the customer; before installation, the fitter checks the part against the bill of materials. Platform outage: notice in the portal and handover to customer service. Misuse: the assistant only has access to catalogue data and the list of machines of its own account, not to data of other accounts, which prevents internal data from being output.
folgenabschaetzungen.massnahmen: AI notice, machine-readable marking and source reference (M-016), test catalogue with 400 questions before every release, block list for assembly and safety questions, penetration test (M-017), monthly review of 50 conversations by customer service, feedback button in every answer. Since the reassessment: monitoring of the search index and parts flagged as safety-relevant only with a referral to customer service (due 31/03/2027).
folgenabschaetzungen.ergebnis: Use justifiable with the measures listed. Transparency obligations under Art. 50(1) and 50(2) implemented. Reassessment when the platform changes its model, with new functions (e.g. ordering through the assistant) and annually.
folgenabschaetzungen.verknuepfteDsfa: No DPIA needed (checked in the record of processing activities)
folgenabschaetzungen.gesellschaft: Easier access to spare parts information around the clock; no influence on the rights of third parties. Customers without portal access still have customer service.
mitgewirkt: Three customers from the portal pilot

neubeurteilungen.anlass: New risks R-029, R-031 and R-033
neubeurteilungen.ergebnis: Safety severity 4 (R-033), reliability 3 (R-029, R-031). Use restricted, parts flagged as safety-relevant only with a referral to customer service (M-040). Still justifiable.

triage.begruendung: Question 2 yes: mistranslated safety and warning notices could endanger operators at the customer. Hence a full assessment, although no safety and warning notices have been translated with the service since 21/08/2026.

folgenabschaetzungen.systembeschreibung: Public translation service with AI without a company account and without a contract. The technical documentation team copies text blocks into the service and transfers the draft translation to the editorial system, where the specialist review follows.
folgenabschaetzungen.verwendungen: Draft translation of descriptive texts (function descriptions, operating steps without warning notices) into French, Italian and Polish.
folgenabschaetzungen.fehlanwendungen: Translation of safety and warning notices; entering confidential design details; adoption without specialist review under time pressure.
folgenabschaetzungen.daten: Standard text blocks from instructions for use and maintenance manuals, no personal data. The service's model and training data is unknown; the terms of use allow the inputs to be used for training.
folgenabschaetzungen.einsatzumfeld: Technical documentation team of three at headquarters. The instructions go with every machine to customers in the EU and Switzerland. Specialist review of every translation: German, English and French in-house, Italian and Polish by commissioned specialist translators; from April 2027 through L-006.

betroffene.gruppe: Operators and maintenance staff at the customer
betroffene.wirkung: Understandable instructions in their language; danger if a warning notice is mistranslated.
Time saved on draft translations; extra effort for the specialist review.

betroffene.gruppe: Customers as deployers of the machines
betroffene.wirkung: Defective instructions for use are a defect of the machine under the Machinery Regulation.

rechenschaft.nutzen: The owner is the Head of Development; the specialist review lies with the documentation team.
rechenschaft.schaden: Used until August 2026 without approval and without anyone responsible.

transparenz.nutzen: The reviewed version in the editorial system is authoritative.
transparenz.schaden: No information from the service on model and training.

fairness.nutzen: After the specialist review, the same quality of instructions in all languages.
fairness.schaden: Without specialist review, poorer instructions for operators using Italian or Polish.

datenschutz.schaden: Without a contract, inputs may be used for training; therefore texts of the class ‘public’ only.

zuverlaessigkeit.nutzen: Usable draft translations of descriptive texts.
zuverlaessigkeit.schaden: Errors in technical terms, units and negations.

sicherheit.schaden: A mistranslated warning notice could endanger operators; the service therefore does not translate warning notices, and every translation undergoes specialist review. Residual risk: errors in descriptive texts that the specialist review also misses.

erklaerbarkeit.nutzen: The reviewed version is authoritative; changes compared with the pre-translation are visible in the editorial system.
erklaerbarkeit.schaden: The service does not explain its translations; only the specialist review detects errors.

umwelt.schaden: Computing effort at the provider, low volume.

folgenabschaetzungen.ausfaelle: Error in a descriptive text: query or operating error, usually caught in the specialist review. Wrong warning notice: danger to people and a defect in the instructions; hence no warning notices in the service. Service unavailable: translation by specialist translators, later delivery of the instructions.
folgenabschaetzungen.massnahmen: No safety and warning notices and only texts of the class ‘public’ in the service (since 21/08/2026); safety and warning notices of the 14 instructions pre-translated since 2025 re-checked by specialist translators by 30/09/2026, without any error changing the meaning (N-057); specialist review of every translation, in-house or by commissioned specialist translators (EC-02); replacement by the service L-006 with specialist translation by 09/04/2027 (M-018), before the exception expires on 12/04/2027. Operators were not consulted directly; instead, complaints and queries about instructions from 2024 to 2026 were analysed (no cases with translation errors).
folgenabschaetzungen.ergebnis: Restricted, time-limited use only until replacement by L-006 (M-018): no safety and warning notices, texts of the class ‘public’ only, specialist review of every translation. The executive board approves the restricted use.
folgenabschaetzungen.gesellschaft: No effect beyond the customers and their staff; correct warning notices protect operators in all languages.

triage.begruendung: Pre-selection affects access to employment (Annex III No. 4(a)), applicants are in a weaker position, CVs sometimes contain sensitive personal data, and applications below the threshold were in effect set aside automatically. Sensitive use.

folgenabschaetzungen.systembeschreibung: The ‘candidate ranking’ function of the HR SaaS compares the CV and cover letter with the job profile and calculates a fit score from 0 to 100. Until it was switched off on 25/08/2026, it sorted the list and marked applications below 40 as ‘low suitability’; the recruiters mostly no longer opened these. It is planned to use it only as a sorting aid without a threshold and without marking.
folgenabschaetzungen.verwendungen: Intended: sorting aid for positions with more than 40 applications; every application is reviewed by a recruiter, and decisions on interviews or rejections are taken jointly by the HR department and line management.
folgenabschaetzungen.fehlanwendungen: Automatic rejections based on the fit score; use for internal promotions or performance appraisals; job profiles with criteria that discriminate indirectly (e.g. age via ‘no more than 5 years of professional experience’); skipping the review under time pressure.
folgenabschaetzungen.daten: Input data: application documents and job profiles. Before a position is advertised, the HR department and line management check the job profile for discriminatory criteria (EUAIA-10). The model's training data is held by the supplier; information on provenance and bias tests has been requested (L-005, PF-05). Linked to DPIA-2026-04.
folgenabschaetzungen.einsatzumfeld: HR department at headquarters for both companies; about 900 applications a year, peaks for apprenticeships and assembly positions. Two recruiters trained in human oversight (K-001). Works council of the German company and staff committee in Switzerland informed.

betroffene.gruppe: Applicants for positions in the German company
betroffene.wirkung: Access to employment; risk of being unjustifiably set aside, from 02/12/2027 rights under Art. 26(11) and 86.
Same effect; rights under the Data Protection Act, AI Act rules applied voluntarily.

betroffene.gruppe: Applicants with gaps in their CV, older applicants, applicants with foreign qualifications
betroffene.wirkung: Higher risk of low fit scores because of patterns in the training data.
Relief with large numbers of applications; danger of relying too much on the score (automation bias).

betroffene.gruppe: Employee representatives (works council DE, staff committee CH)
betroffene.wirkung: Participation in the introduction, right to information under Art. 26(7).

rechenschaft.nutzen: Head of Human Resources as system owner, decisions always taken by people, documented review.
rechenschaft.schaden: Until August 2026 the function ran without the knowledge of those responsible; there was no accountability.

transparenz.nutzen: Notice in job advertisements and the privacy notice, explanation on request (M-020).
transparenz.schaden: Applicants did not know that their documents were being evaluated (R-020).

fairness.nutzen: Consistent sorting against the job profile.
fairness.schaden: Indirect discrimination by age, origin or gender through patterns in the model; bias test with the supplier before the system is put back into service (M-019) (R-019).

datenschutz.nutzen: Processing in Germany, data processing agreement, DPIA-2026-04.
datenschutz.schaden: Profiling with sensitive personal data; data minimization by hiding photo, date of birth and nationality before the evaluation.

zuverlaessigkeit.schaden: Unsuitable scores for atypical CVs, career changers and apprenticeships; therefore not used there.

sicherheit.nutzen: Access only for the HR department, logging for 12 months.
sicherheit.schaden: No danger to life and limb.

erklaerbarkeit.nutzen: The software shows the three most important matches and gaps per application.
erklaerbarkeit.schaden: Weighting in the model cannot be traced; an explanation under Art. 86 is only possible with information from the supplier.

umwelt.schaden: Low computing effort at the supplier.

folgenabschaetzungen.ausfaelle: Unjustifiably low fit score: a suitable person is reviewed later or not at all; harm to the person and to us (missed skilled worker, discrimination lawsuit). Function failure: review as before 2026 without sorting, no harm. Misconfiguration through a supplier update: the function could become active again; the HR department checks after every release that it stays switched off.
folgenabschaetzungen.massnahmen: Function switched off until M-019 is completed; afterwards only a sorting aid without a threshold, every application reviewed by a trained recruiter; photo, date of birth and nationality hidden; bias test with the supplier; information of applicants and explanation procedure (M-020); information of employee representatives (done on 14/10/2026); applicants were not consulted directly, their view was brought in by the works council and the staff committee, and we will survey 20 applicants before the system is put back into service (M-019); logs kept for 12 months; half-yearly sample of 30 applications by the Head of Human Resources; DPIA-2026-04. Consequences of the silent activation: HR re-checked all 112 applications marked as ‘low suitability’ between February and August 2026 by 30/09/2026; 9 people were invited afterwards or approached for a similar position, and all 112 people received information about the pre-selection and their right of access (N-057).
folgenabschaetzungen.ergebnis: Put back into service only as a sorting aid with the measures listed and after approval by the executive board, prepared by 30/09/2027 at the latest so that the deployer obligations from 02/12/2027 are met. Not used for apprenticeships. Reassessment before the system is put back into service and with every supplier release that changes the function.
folgenabschaetzungen.verknuepfteDsfa: DPIA-2026-04 applicant management (Art. 22 FADP, Art. 35 GDPR)
folgenabschaetzungen.gesellschaft: Biased pre-selection could disadvantage groups on the labour market; therefore the function is switched off until the bias tests are documented.

massnahmen.titel: Information of applicants and explanation procedure
