massnahmen.beschreibung: Remote access only via the ISMS remote maintenance process with case-by-case enabling and logging of every session, release notes with information on the base model; after finding F-002 extended by the obligation to announce model changes 30 days in advance.

massnahmen.titel: AI literacy training for all users
massnahmen.beschreibung: 45-minute e-learning (how it works, limits, rules, reporting channel) and a team meeting per department; mandatory for everyone with access to generative AI, refreshed annually; follow-up training for the field service in January 2027.

massnahmen.titel: Sample checks of generative AI results
massnahmen.beschreibung: Key users check 20 results from quotations and design for errors every quarter; measurement for objective Z-003, carried out by the key users on behalf of the AIMS lead.

massnahmen.titel: Monitor legal acts under the Machinery Regulation and review the classification
massnahmen.beschreibung: Follow drafts of the delegated act on Annex III of the Machinery Regulation, have the classification of MX-Predict and the planned version 3.0 reviewed by lawyers.

massnahmen.titel: Launch the service offer ‘Plannable maintenance’
massnahmen.beschreibung: Service contract with analysis of maintenance notices, pilot with 5 customers, then roll-out in CH and DE.

massnahmen.titel: Restrict the training function in the camera system to the QA role
massnahmen.beschreibung: Set permissions in the camera system so that only QA can retrain; train shift supervisors on the approval procedure.

massnahmen.titel: Half-yearly feature scan of SaaS services for AI
massnahmen.beschreibung: IT and purchasing evaluate the release notes of the SaaS services and the AI suppliers every six months and before every major update for new AI functions and model changes; check item PF-06 added to the ISMS supplier assessment.

massnahmen.titel: Update the AI Act status before stage 1
massnahmen.beschreibung: Check whether new consolidations, corrigenda or guidelines have been published since the version of 27/07/2026; update E-02, E-03 and E-09.

massnahmen.titel: Protect Copilot against prepared emails
massnahmen.beschreibung: Restrict external images and links in answers, agents and connectors only after approval, repeat the misuse cases with prepared emails after larger provider updates, remind all users to report conspicuous answers.

massnahmen.titel: Cost cap and per-account limits for the spare parts assistant
massnahmen.beschreibung: Hard cost cap at the cloud AI platform (L-004), limit on requests per account and hour, length limits for input and answers, daily consumption report to customer service.

massnahmen.titel: Write permissions and approval for changes to the knowledge base
massnahmen.beschreibung: Write permissions on the catalogue and bills of materials for the editorial team only, approval of imported supplier data by a second person, change log, test case with a prepared entry in every release test.

massnahmen.titel: Complete the measurement and test plan for all approved systems
massnahmen.beschreibung: For KI-001, KI-003, KI-004 and KI-005, add a test with threshold and frequency for each of the most important trustworthiness characteristics, collect test cases from operation and update the results every quarter (N-03).

massnahmen.titel: Monitor new and hard-to-measure AI risks every six months
massnahmen.beschreibung: Six-monthly round in the AIMS team on new types of attack, the legal situation, feedback and near misses; result as a new risk in the register or as a note in the profile N-01.

massnahmen.titel: Repeat misuse cases for ChatGPT Team with prepared web pages and files
massnahmen.beschreibung: Every six months and after larger changes to the service, test 6 misuse cases with prepared web pages, customer emails and files; tell users not to open links in answers without checking them.

massnahmen.titel: Anchor the reassessment after every retraining in QS-F-118
massnahmen.beschreibung: Add the mandatory step ‘reassess the risks of the system, check the screening’ to form QS-F-118; the system owner records the date in the risk register, the AIMS lead confirms the step before the model version is approved. D-12 section 8 names every retraining as a trigger (version 1.1).

massnahmen.titel: Record AI incidents in the register on the day of the report
massnahmen.beschreibung: Record events that are AI incidents or near misses under D-14-EB in the register D-22-EB on the day they are reported, even if they are already being handled; every month, reconcile reports, shadow AI cases and changes in the inventory with the register and report the result in the ISMS round.

massnahmen.beschreibung: Walk through the steps of PR-14 on a retired test system of development: access, data, records, inventory. KI-008 is only suspended and is to go back into operation after M-019.

feststellungen.beschreibung: The retraining of the quality inspection on 20/11/2026 (model version 3.2) was carried out by a shift supervisor without approval using form QS-F-118; the check against the test set was only done afterwards, and the reassessment of the screening was missing.
feststellungen.korrektur: Subsequent verification against the test set on 25/11/2026 (detection rate unchanged); approval obtained retrospectively. After the audit, screening IA-001 and all risks of KI-001 (R-005, R-006, R-007, R-022, R-024) reassessed on 28/01/2027, residual risks of R-005 to R-007 accepted again on 02/02/2027; the reassessment after every retraining is a mandatory step in QS-F-118 and D-12 (M-035). Reporting obligation checked: no defective part delivered, no report to customers needed.
feststellungen.ursache: The approval procedure had only been trained in QA; in the camera system all users could retrain. The procedure required a reassessment of the risks only for a substantial change, the risk procedure after every retraining.
feststellungen.nachweis: Change log of the camera system with model version 3.2 of 20/11/2026 (user account of a shift supervisor), no form QS-F-118 for this version, interview with Thomas Gerber.
feststellungen.aehnlicheFaelle: Checked: retraining for KI-002 and KI-003 followed D-12 with approval; no other case.

feststellungen.beschreibung: New AI functions in existing SaaS services are not detected between the annual supplier reviews, because nobody evaluates the release notes. The silently activated pre-selection (KI-008) was only found through the inventory interview; a release of the HR SaaS of 15/12/2026 with a new AI function for summarizing job interviews had not been checked by the time of the audit.
feststellungen.korrektur: Release of 15/12/2026 checked on 20/01/2027: new function switched off and noted in the inventory for KI-008. Reporting obligation checked: no report needed.
feststellungen.ursache: The supplier review is set up annually; nobody is responsible for releases between reviews.
feststellungen.nachweis: Release notes of the HR SaaS of 15/12/2026 without a review note, supplier assessment L-005 in review record N-026, interviews with Claudia Frei and Marco Huber.
feststellungen.aehnlicheFaelle: Release notes of all SaaS services since July 2026 checked: no further case. Similar risk identified at the camera supplier and recorded as R-024.

feststellungen.beschreibung: An employee in purchasing had Copilot summarize an email from an unknown sender. The summary asked the employee to send the current price list ‘for review’ via a link; the email contained hidden text for this. The employee sent nothing and reported the answer through the reporting channel. No data left the company.
feststellungen.korrektur: Email and sender blocked in the email filter; Copilot log evaluated: no further summary of this email. Duty to notify checked: no data leaked, no notification needed.
feststellungen.ursache: Copilot processes content from unknown senders with the users' rights, and its answers were allowed to contain external links.
feststellungen.nachweis: Report in the AIMS mailbox of 25/01/2027, evaluation of the Copilot log, ticket in the ISMS incident procedure.
feststellungen.aehnlicheFaelle: Logs of Copilot and ChatGPT Team for January 2027 checked for similar emails: no further case.

feststellungen.beschreibung: Technical writing has used a free translation service without a contract since 2025 and entered complete instructions for use with design details; the terms of use allow training with the inputs. Discovered in the inventory survey on 20/08/2026, handled as shadow AI (R-017, R-018) and only recorded as an AI incident with the management review.
feststellungen.korrektur: Since 21/08/2026 only descriptive text blocks of the class ‘public’ without safety and warning notices in the service; checked that no special machines with a confidentiality agreement are affected (no information of customers needed); safety and warning notices of the 14 pre-translated instructions re-checked by specialist translators by 30/09/2026, without any error changing the meaning (N-057). Reporting obligation checked: no personal data, no breach of contract, no report needed.
feststellungen.ursache: Before the AIMS there was no approval process for AI tools and no approved translation tool; under time pressure, technical writing used a freely available service. The case was handled before the register was set up and was not added afterwards as an incident.
feststellungen.nachweis: Response to the inventory survey of 20/08/2026, condition in the approval list of 21/08/2026, review records of the specialist translations (N-057), supplier review L-007.
feststellungen.aehnlicheFaelle: Inventory survey in all departments and interviews: one further case (F-007).

feststellungen.beschreibung: The AI function ‘candidate ranking’ of the HR SaaS had been active since a release in February 2026 without HR knowing. It marked applications below a threshold as ‘low suitability’; these applications were mostly no longer opened. The system could thus disadvantage applicants. Discovered in the inventory interview on 25/08/2026 and switched off the same day; handled as shadow AI (R-019, R-020, IA-008) and only recorded as an AI incident with the management review.
feststellungen.korrektur: Function switched off on 25/08/2026. Consequences for the applicants: by 30/09/2026 HR re-checked all 112 applications from February to August 2026 marked as ‘low suitability’; 9 people were invited afterwards or approached for a similar position, and all 112 received information about the pre-selection and their right of access (N-057). The data protection advisor reviewed the information. Reporting obligation checked: no data security breach, no report to the supervisory authority needed; the employee representatives were informed on 14/10/2026.
feststellungen.ursache: The supplier activated the function by default with a release; release notes were not evaluated (F-002). The case was handled before the register was set up and was not added afterwards as an incident.
feststellungen.nachweis: Minutes of the inventory interview of 25/08/2026, configuration log of the HR SaaS, list of the re-checked applications and information letters (N-057), minutes N-038.
feststellungen.aehnlicheFaelle: Release notes of all SaaS services since July 2026 checked (F-002): no further case.
